name: Tray stack
summary: A stacking game in the dining hall: today's food swings over your tray on a serving scoop, tap to drop each piece, the tower leans as it goes off-centre and comes down when the weight hangs past an edge. Height is the score; friends' faces sit on a ruler at the height they reached.
useWhen: arun stacked 23 things on his tray at hollis, beat that
a quick game about the dining hall
something to play while we wait in the brunch line
challenge the group to a stacking game
dontUseWhen: a game with words or trivia (use trivia-night)

sub.description: Line under the title, e.g. 'Hollis Dining Hall · tap to drop'

menu.description: Words on the menu board on the wall, e.g. 'Hollis · Sunday brunch'

foods.description: Foods on the line today, 1 to 8: a name and a drawn kind

board.description: Friends' best stacks already played: name, items stacked, an optional line in their words
